items.title: GE HealthCare Technologies (GEHC) Led A $160 Million Cardiac Imaging Investment
items.summary: GE HealthCare Technologies (NasdaqGS:GEHC) led Laza Medical's Series B round, raising US$160 million to fund AI-based cardiac imaging. The financing aims to advance robotic imaging systems for cardiac procedures using artificial intelligence tools in clinical workflows. The partners plan broader integration of imaging modalities in cardiac catheterization labs to streamline procedure planning and execution.
